points.why: It says a diagram that looks authoritative and has plausible arrows isn't shown to be true, but never says a clean first draft deserves more suspicion.
It says to run each link past CS, sales and product, ask whether they would defend it, and keep their corrections.
It treats the archetype as a separate check from the polarity trace and gives the canonical definition: a fix whose own delayed side effect worsens the problem.
It says the authoritative look and the AI vouching for its own trace are not evidence the diagram is right.

pitfalls.why: It explicitly questions the Fixes That Fail label and says to drop it if no specific fix and side effect can be found.
